# Show the total on the All examples navigation row

## Context

The Portal Examples overview headline and sidebar footer display the distinct example total. The operator requested the same total beside the All examples navigation link. This is a small presentation leaf under #21140.

## The Problem

The All examples row has a label and icon while the group rows carry their counts. This makes the overall catalog size harder to find in the sidebar and mobile groups sheet.

## The Architectural Reality

[GroupIndex](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/d50145cfd54dbe507a2576b8c834d5be36a17860/apps/portal/view/examples/GroupIndex.mjs#L156-L205) already computes the published total for the footer by summing the canonical group counts. Borrowed examples are shown by multiple groups. The groups’ visible and accessible count conventions supply the existing design.

Design authority: the operator requested the total in the Examples sidebar, and the #21140 design owner approved the shared group-count style and accessible name.

## The Fix

Render the computed total beside All examples using the group count class. Use the existing count-label formatter for its accessible name. Exercise the same row in the existing catalog tests.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The All examples row shows the distinct total from the current build catalog, matching the overview headline and footer total.
- [ ] The accessible name includes that total on the desktop and in the phone groups sheet. The active route and keyboard behavior still work.
- [ ] Changing between Production and Dev mode updates the total with the catalog. The tests retain the case where the sum of visible group counts exceeds the distinct total.

## Out of Scope

Catalog organization, search semantics, group counts, footer copy and the compact selector label.
